subject: geography

provenance.source: AglaSem Docs copy of the NTA master question paper (CUET UG 2026 Question Paper Geography and Geology, 41 PDF pages: a cover plus 40 numbered pages), https://docs.aglasem.com/view/7025c4b2-c701-11f1-a920-0aa932765c8b, PDF https://cdn.aglasem.com/aglasem-doc/7025c4b2-c701-11f1-a920-0aa932765c8b/7025c4b2-c701-11f1-a920-0aa932765c8b.pdf (9,253,417 bytes, ETag a10882e42d56b568fdf01186f7b5c693, Last-Modified 13 Oct 2026), downloaded 22 Nov 2026 under the owner's 22 Nov 2026 request for more subjects. English text from two OCR drafts (Windows OCR and RapidOCR) cross-checked against each other and the page images. Answers from NTA's CUET (UG) 2026 final answer key (option ids), subject 313.
provenance.keySource: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 24-05-2026 (Second) final key for subject 313 and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.

bankRead: No new production read by B. Worked from A's saved snapshot of 22 Nov 2026 (tmp/1122-coverage/snap/geography/: served_rows.json, served_geography.json 214 ids = the eligible ids in eligible.txt; the 9 visible-but-not-eligible rows are excluded). Card suspension not re-read (no second production read).
keyCardDeck: data/keycards/decks/geography.json (v3, 1,345 cards); data/keycards/quarantine/geography.json (238 cards, not served) searched for near-misses only
syllabusSource: Bank and deck chapter names for geography (Fundamentals of Human Geography and India: People and Economy); every question sits on the 2026 syllabus. Chapter labels for items 18 and 22 are best guesses where the bank has no home for the fact.
method: data/coverage/METHOD.md strict rule. B wrote its own facts from the paper before opening A (tmp/1122-coverage/checkerB-geo/B_facts_before_A.txt), searched every question in the served rows, the deck and the NCERT text (pdftotext of ncert-books/pdf/legy1xx-2xx; pdfium for tables) with checkerB-geo/multi.mjs, s.mjs, ctx.mjs, pdfium_grep.py; verified every id A cited with checkerB-geo/verifyA.mjs; built by checkerB-geo/buildB.py.
paperStructure: One compulsory Geography paper of 50 questions: Sub-section 1 = 40 single questions (Q51-90: one-line MCQs, 5 sequence, 5 statement, 5 match), Sub-section 2 = a passage on high-technology industry with 5 questions (Q91-95), Sub-section 3 = a passage on rail transport with 5 questions (Q96-100). The printed header says 42 questions; fifty ids are printed and the key has 50 rows for this shift.

auditOfA.note: Every bank id A cited is in served_geography.json and was read in full (stem, options, key, explanation); every card id is in the published deck and its front, back and quote were read. Each states what A attached to it. Corrections that are not removals: Q18's chapter is Human Geography - Nature & Scope (legy101 p2), and Q24 is a concept match, not same.

settled.23: B's first reading was covered-concept (Gulf of Mexico implies North America); settled to not covered: the card's answer side never names the USA or the continent, and the strict rule needs the fact stated.
settled.45: B planned skill; settled to not covered: the passage prints 'near Seattle' but not the country, so the answer is not readable off the passage, and served material never says Seattle is in the USA.

final.rule: Covered only if both A and B say covered; B's skill, off-syllabus and dropped labels win.

openCallsSettled.call: Near-miss: card fact-north-pacific-ports puts Seattle among ports 'on the American side' of the west coast of North America; reaching USA still needs the unstated step, so not covered.
Near-miss: card fact-big-inch has the tag 'U.S.A.' but tags are not the answer side; not covered.
Statements B and C alone pick option 4 (A, B and C); a card stating B and C would close it.
Skill by elimination: the passage names hill states, north-eastern states and Rajasthan as less dense.
